insight: Its AI inside-sales agent is named 'Aisa Holmes,' and the platform now nurtures mortgage leads beyond its real-estate roots.
name: Structurely
tagline: Conversational AI inside-sales agent for real-estate leads.
description: Structurely runs an AI inside-sales agent that engages new real-estate and mortgage leads over SMS, web chat, and voice, qualifying them on timeline, budget, and motivation. It books appointments, performs live phone transfers to a human agent, and keeps nurturing leads for over a year until they are sales-ready. It plugs into CRMs such as Follow Up Boss, HubSpot, and Salesforce.
edge: Purpose-built AI inside-sales agent that texts, calls, and live-transfers real-estate leads, then nurtures them for 12+ months.
pros: Engages new leads within about a minute
Live transfer to a human agent
cons: Paid only; setup fee on some tiers

references.title: The real estate chatbot helping agents sell more homes
